# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(goeveg)
library(ggbiplot)
library(tidyplots)
```

# LC-MS dataset

```{r}
# load in and tidy lcms metadata
lcms_metadata <- readxl::read_excel(
  "data/metabolomics/mx 885019_Caro_soil extract_HILIC_submit 08-2025_tidy.xlsx",
  sheet = "Metadata"
) |>
  filter(Label == "Sample #") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Label,
    values_to = "sample_number",
    names_to = "sample_id"
  ) |>
  select(-Label) |>
  filter(sample_number != "Blank", sample_number != "Pool")


lcms <- readxl::read_excel(
  "data/metabolomics/mx 885019_Caro_soil extract_HILIC_submit 08-2025_tidy.xlsx"
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  # remove blanks and pools
  select(!contains("blank")) |>
  select(!contains("pool")) |>
  # make sure all values are numeric
  mutate(
    across(.cols = contains("x"), .fns = as.numeric)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("x"),
    values_to = "peak_height",
    names_to = "sample_number"
  ) |>
  mutate(m_z = as.numeric(m_z)) |>
  mutate(
    sample_number = str_remove(sample_number, "x")
  ) |>
  left_join(lcms_metadata, by = "sample_number") |>
  # add in metadata
  mutate(
    site = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "JCR") ~ "JCR",
      str_detect(sample_id, "LOM") ~ "LOM",
    ),
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "ROS") ~ "Drought",
      str_detect(sample_id, "SKY") ~ "Control"
    ),
    dt = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "72hr") ~ "72hr",
      str_detect(sample_id, "0hr") ~ "0hr",
      str_detect(sample_id, "24hr") ~ "24hr"
    ),
    rep = case_when(
      str_detect(sample_id, "rep1") ~ 1,
      str_detect(sample_id, "rep2") ~ 2,
      str_detect(sample_id, "rep3") ~ 3
    )
  )

```


```{r}
p_lcms_tile <- lcms |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      y = metabolite_name,
      x = sample_id,
      fill = peak_height,
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
lcms |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = sample_id,
      y = peak_height,
      label = metabolite_name,
      color = condition,
      shape = site
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 5)) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
    data = lcms |>
      filter(peak_height > 1.5e6),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 1
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    #legend.position = "none"
  )
#plotly::ggplotly()
```

```{r}
lcms |>
  filter(metabolite_name == "betaine") |>
  filter(!is.na(dt)) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = dt,
      y = peak_height,
      color = condition,
      shape = site
    )
  ) +
  #geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(vars(site), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "black", "Drought" = "red")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
lcms |>
  filter(metabolite_name == "betaine") |>
  filter(!is.na(site)) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  mutate(normalized = peak_height / max(peak_height, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  tidyplot(x = dt, y = normalized, color = condition) |>
  add_mean_bar(alpha = 0.4) |>
  add_sem_errorbar() |>
  add(labs(x = "Time after rewetting", y = "Normalized Abundance")) |>
  add(scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = FALSE)) |>
  adjust_size(height = 60, width = 60) |>
  split_plot(by = site)

```

Convert data to matrix format for NMDS

```{r}
lcms.nmds <- lcms |>
  select(
    sample_id,
    metabolite_name,
    peak_height,
    site,
    condition,
    dt,
    rep
  ) |>
  mutate_at(vars(site, condition, dt, rep), as.factor) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(metabolite_name),
    !is.na(site),
    !is.na(condition)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = peak_height
  )


```


```{r}
lcms.wide <- lcms |>
  select(
    sample_id,
    site,
    condition,
    dt,
    rep,
    metabolite_name,
    peak_height
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(metabolite_name)) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(sample_id, site, condition, dt, rep),
    names_from = metabolite_name,
    values_from = peak_height
  )


lcms.pca <- prcomp(
  lcms.wide |>
    # extract the numeric columns for PCA
    select(-c(sample_id, site, condition, dt, rep)) |>
    # missing values are replaced with 0
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
)
plot(lcms.pca)

screeplot(lcms.pca, type = "line")

p1 <- ggbiplot(
  lcms.pca,
  groups = lcms.wide$condition,
  var.axes = FALSE
) +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggbiplot(
  lcms.pca,
  groups = lcms.wide$site,
  var.axes = FALSE
) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw()

cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```

biplot tutorial

```{r}
data(crime)

crime |> knitr::kable()

crime.pca <-
  crime |>
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  prcomp(scale. = TRUE)

crime.pca


ggbiplot(
  crime.pca,
  labels = crime$st,
  circle = TRUE,
  varname.size = 4,
  varname.color = "red"
)

# The groups argument allows the observations to colored by group and to summarized by groups.
crime.pca <- reflect(crime.pca)

ggbiplot(
  crime.pca,
  groups = crime$region,
  labels = crime$st,
  labels.size = 4,
  var.factor = 1.4,
  ellipse = TRUE,
  ellipse.level = 0.5,
  ellipse.alpha = 0.1,
  circle = TRUE,
  varname.size = 4,
  varname.color = "black"
) +
  labs(fill = "Region", color = "Region") +
  theme(legend.direction = 'horizontal', legend.position = 'top')
```
